agent_access_rule: No workspace, memory, other-agent or prior-design reads; derive only from supplied brief.
comparison_rule: Compare necessary distinctions, behavioral predictions, costs, scope and newly exposed failure cases, not vocabulary agreement.
limitations: Behavioral requirements were extracted by the existing designer, so selection/framing bias remains possible.
Independent derivation by another agent is corroboration, not proof of optimality or implemented correctness.
agent_provenance_report: The agent reports no tools, files, memories, other agents, prior conversation or external materials were consulted before its answer; it used the supplied brief, visible general instructions and general knowledge.
